# FraudBad

> Source-cited ledger of U.S. government spending fraud cases and federal improper payments by state, agency, and program, cited to OIG, DOJ, and GAO records.

Last reviewed: 2026-11-27

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://fraudbad.com/): Overview of documented government spending fraud cases.
- [The Ledger](https://fraudbad.com/ledger): Federal improper payments ledger by agency and program.
- [Soft Fraud](https://fraudbad.com/soft-fraud): Legalized waste and undocumented spending patterns.
- [Where Receipts Stop](https://fraudbad.com/transparency): Public spending transparency gaps.
- [States](https://fraudbad.com/states): Cases and audits organized by state.
- [Agencies](https://fraudbad.com/agencies): Cases and improper payments organized by agency.
- [Method](https://fraudbad.com/method): Sourcing and editorial methodology.
